description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a detailed 'Card Information' screen, including layout, visual decorations, navigation, and UI components like cards, buttons, charts, and legends.

classes.name: CardScreen315
classes.description: Main widget representing the 'Card Information' screen, built with a combination of stacked Positioned widgets to mimic pixel-perfect Figma layouts.

classes.name: _LegendColumn
classes.description: Widget that displays the legend for the analytics donut chart.

classes.name: _LegendRow
classes.description: Widget representing a single row in the legend with a color indicator and label.

classes.name: _Bar
classes.description: Small widget used in the legend to indicate chart segments.

classes.name: _MaskedDigits
classes.description: Widget displaying masked card digits with a prefix of dots followed by last four digits.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the entire CardInformation screen UI with header, cards, stats, and charts.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Creates the header with back button and title.

methods.name: addCardPill
methods.description: Creates the 'Add new card' pill button.

methods.name: bigCard
methods.description: Creates the large gradient card with decoration and masked digits.

methods.name: smallCard
methods.description: Creates the smaller gradient card with decoration and masked digits.

methods.name: statCard
methods.description: Creates individual statistic mini-cards for 'Earn' and 'Spend'.

methods.name: analytics
methods.description: Creates the donut chart, legend, and percentage chip for analytics.
